publications.title: SteerDuplex: Steerable Duplex Speech Dialogue Models
publications.venue: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop RTCA | Under submission ARR
publications.name: SteerDuplex
publications.description: Steerable full-duplex speech dialogue through supervised fine-tuning and two-stage reinforcement learning, with control over vocal delivery and conversational behavior.
publications.alt: SteerDuplex training pipeline, from supervised fine-tuning to continuity and listener-feedback reinforcement learning.

publications.title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR
publications.name: POW3R
publications.description: Policy-aware rubric rewards prioritize criteria that distinguish a model’s current responses, reaching comparable performance in 2.5–4× fewer training steps.
publications.alt: POW3R rubric audit contrasting human importance weights with the learning signal available to the current policy.

publications.title: Humanity’s Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models
publications.name: Humanity’s Sixth Sense
publications.description: A benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning across temporal, spatial, social, and abstract tasks, examining the gap between multimodal models and human judgment.
publications.alt: Example questions from the temporal, spatial, social, and abstract reasoning domains in Humanity’s Sixth Sense.

publications.title: Rubric Dropout: A Simple Way to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Rubric-as-Reward RL
publications.name: Rubric Dropout
publications.description: Randomly masks rubric criteria during reinforcement learning to reduce overfitting to a fixed reward signal and mitigate reward hacking.
publications.alt: Diagram comparing conventional neuron dropout with criterion masking in Rubric Dropout.

publications.title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
publications.name: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation
publications.description: Distills a rubric-conditioned teacher into a prompt-only student using token-level feedback, removing external verifier calls from the training loop.
publications.alt: Method overview comparing judge-based GRPO with rubric-conditioned teacher-to-student distillation.

publications.title: Audio MultiChallenge: A Multi-Turn Evaluation of Spoken Dialogue Systems on Natural Human Interaction
publications.name: Audio MultiChallenge
publications.description: Tests spoken dialogue systems on natural multi-turn interaction, including memory, instruction retention, self-coherence, and voice editing.
publications.alt: Spoken dialogue examples covering memory, instruction retention, self-coherence, and voice editing in Audio MultiChallenge.

news.text: New paper: {hss}, a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning in multimodal models.
{pow3r} will appear at NeurIPS 2026. {steerduplex} will appear at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop RTCA.
{beyond-seeing} will appear at EMNLP 2026. Our new {rubric-dropout} paper is available.
{audiomc} received the ACL 2026 Best Resource Paper Award, shared with my coauthors.
{audio-hallucination} will appear at Interspeech 2026. Our new {rgsd} paper is available.
{scipredict} will appear at ICML 2026, and {audiomc} at ACL 2026.
Granted {patent}, on scheduling abstractive summaries for multi-party communication channels.
{multivox} and {egoillusion} will appear at EMNLP 2025.
Joined Scale AI as a Machine Learning Research Engineer, working on audio and multimodal AI.
Completed my M.S. in Computer Science at the University of Maryland, College Park.
{mmau} was selected for a Spotlight at ICLR 2025.
{mmau} and {vdgd} will appear at ICLR 2025.
Awarded a $7,000 NeuroPAC Fellowship at UMD/UMIACS for research on EEG-based brain–computer interaction using LLMs.
One paper accepted to Interspeech 2024, two to ACL 2024, and two to NAACL 2024.
{compa} accepted to ICLR 2024.
Attended EMNLP in person in Singapore.
Two papers accepted to EMNLP 2023.
Started my M.S. in Computer Science at the University of Maryland, College Park.
One paper accepted to ICCV 2023.
One paper accepted to Interspeech 2023.
One paper accepted to ACL 2023 and one to SIGIR 2023.
Our work on implicit hate speech in online conversations was accepted to the De-Factify 2 workshop at AAAI 2023.
Filed two patents with Atlassian on incident management in multi-party communication channels. Promoted to Software Engineer 2 and began collaborating with GAMMA Lab at the University of Maryland.
Joined MIDAS Lab at IIIT Delhi.
Joined Atlassian as a Software Engineer.
